note: Execution environment that produced every artifact in this repository. Read from the live interpreter and binaries on 2026-09-22, not typed from memory. tools/check_env.py compares a candidate machine against this file.
platform_notes: Nothing in the deterministic half is OS-specific: paths go through pathlib, JSON is read as UTF-8, and the unit suite blocks sockets. The LaTeX toolchain is the only host-sensitive part, which is why pandoc and tectonic are pinned below and why Dockerfile exists.

pandoc.role: markdown to LaTeX, then invokes the PDF engine

tectonic.role: PDF engine. Chosen over a TeX Live install because it fetches missing .sty files itself, which is what makes config/tex/manuscript_head.tex (siunitx + mhchem) work on a bare machine.

llm_endpoints.note: Tier 2 only. These are NOT pinnable: the providers update weights behind a stable model name, so an identical prompt is not guaranteed to give an identical completion, and no manifest can change that. This is why the reproducibility claim in the paper is scoped to the deterministic half. config/models.yaml holds the pins that DO exist (model slug, variant, temperature 0).

deterministic: every gate in s18d_build_v4.py / h1_build_v6.py / s18y_build_yearly.py
corpus normalisation, dedupe, venue percentiles, subset scoring
all statistics and figure data tables
